q: The old building was so _____ that nobody wanted to buy it.
translation: 那栋旧楼太丑了，没人想买。

q: _____, the success of the plan depends on everyone's cooperation.
translation: 最终，计划的成功取决于每个人的合作。

q: Do not forget to bring an _____ in case it starts to rain.
translation: 别忘了带雨伞，以防下雨。

q: My _____ taught me how to ride a bike when I was five years old.
translation: 我叔叔在我五岁时教会了我骑自行车。

q: The city has an extensive _____ railway system.
translation: 这座城市有庞大的地下铁路系统。

q: The animals dug _____ to escape the cold winter weather.
translation: 动物们挖到地下以躲避寒冷的冬季。

q: His instructions were clear and easily _____ by all the new staff.
explain: understand v. 理解。过去式 understood。
translation: 他的指示很清晰，所有新员工都能轻松理解。

q: All students must wear a school _____ during weekday classes.
translation: 所有学生在上课日必须穿校服。

q: The walls were painted a _____ color throughout the entire building.
translation: 整栋楼的墙壁都漆成了统一的颜色。

q: Each person's fingerprints are _____ and cannot be copied exactly.
translation: 每个人的指纹都是独特的，无法被精确复制。

q: We are studying the basic _____ of weight in our science class.
translation: 我们在科学课上学习重量的基本单位。

q: The _____ is believed to be about fourteen billion years old.
translation: 据信宇宙大约有140亿年的历史。

q: She hopes to attend a top _____ to study medicine next autumn.
translation: 她希望明年秋天进入一所顶尖大学学习医学。

q: It is _____ for snow to fall in this warm coastal region.
translation: 在这个温暖的沿海地区下雪是很不寻常的。

q: The latest software _____ fixed several security problems.
translation: 最新的软件更新修复了几个安全问题。

q: She _____ her resume before applying for the new position.
explain: update v. 更新。过去式 updated。
translation: 她在申请新职位前更新了简历。

q: The _____ floor of the building has a beautiful view of the park.
translation: 这栋楼的上层可以看到公园的美景。

q: The child was very _____ when his favorite toy broke into pieces.
translation: 当最喜欢的玩具摔碎时，孩子非常难过。

q: It is _____ to see so much good food thrown away every day.
explain: upset v. 使难过。现在分词 upsetting。
translation: 看到每天有这么多好的食物被扔掉真是令人难过。

q: _____ areas usually have more job opportunities than rural regions.
translation: 城市地区通常比农村地区有更多的就业机会。

q: I felt a sudden _____ to call my parents after hearing the good news.
translation: 听到好消息后，我突然有一种给父母打电话的冲动。

q: The coach _____ the team to practice harder before the final game.
explain: urge v. 敦促。过去式 urged。
translation: 教练敦促队员们在决赛前更加努力训练。

q: This is an _____ matter that requires immediate attention today.
translation: 这是一件紧急的事情，需要今天立即处理。

q: The _____ of mobile phones is not allowed during the examination.
translation: 考试期间不允许使用手机。

q: She is _____ a new method to teach children how to read.
explain: use v. 使用。现在分词 using。
translation: 她正在使用一种新方法教孩子们阅读。

q: He bought a _____ car because a new one was too expensive.
translation: 他买了一辆二手车，因为新车太贵了。

q: This app is very _____ for learning English vocabulary every day.
translation: 这个应用对每天学习英语词汇非常有用。

q: I went to my _____ coffee shop and ordered a hot latte.
translation: 我去了我常去的咖啡店，点了一杯热拿铁。

q: I _____ walk to school, but today I took the bus instead.
translation: 我通常走路去学校，但今天我坐了公交车。
